title: 🚨🚨🚨 Breaking News:
text:
"🚨🚨🚨 Breaking News:"

"An informed official within the Iranian armed forces, speaking to the Fars News Agency, issued a warning regarding the potential consequences of any U.S. military action against Iran. "

"The official stated that if the U.S. attacks Iranian civilian infrastructure tonight, then Dubai and Abu Dhabi airports, as well as the ports of Fujairah and Jebel Ali in the UAE, must be evacuated immediately in order to protect civilian lives from Iran's retaliatory strikes."
